title: Quick Tire Pressure Check
caption: Keeping your tires at the right pressure improves fuel economy and safety. Use a gauge when the tires are cold and aim for the recommended PSI found on the driver door jamb. Check monthly to stay safe on Saskatoon roads.
image_prompt: A hand holding a tire pressure gauge next to a car tire, early morning light in Saskatoon.

title: Winter Brake Safety
caption: Before the cold sets in, test your brakes and replace worn pads. If you hear squealing or feel vibrations, get it checked now to avoid hazardous stops on icy streets. Your safety matters.
image_prompt: A close‑up of a brake disc with frost, a mechanic's gloved hand inspecting it, winter Saskatoon backdrop.

title: Skip the Tow, We Come to You
caption: When your vehicle won’t start in a Saskatoon neighbourhood, avoid the hassle of a tow and waiting at a shop. Our mobile mechanic arrives at your location, diagnoses, and fixes on the spot—saving you time and trouble.
image_prompt: A mobile mechanic van parked in a residential Saskatoon driveway, a friendly technician waving, car in background.
